Limitations: observed years (2019-2025) differ from the 2013 weather year (inter-annual +-5-10 %); with unknown turbines alpha absorbs turbine differences; offshore wind has no observation and is not calibrated; Ember does not split onshore / intertidal (VN intertidal farms included); farm cells at 0.3 deg

Calibration turbine at the existing farms: atlite NREL_ReferenceTurbine_2020ATB_4MW (4 MW, rotor 150 m, 226 W/m2, hub 110 m), low-specific-power reference comparable to 2018-2022 low-wind turbines; GEM carries no wind turbine model; Vestas V112 (310.6 W/m2, hub 80 m) reported as comparison; alpha absorbs turbine differences (limitation)

Cross-check only (no network variant): alpha_GWA = GWA 3.3 country land-mean 100 m speed / ERA5 2013 land mean (1.10-1.89); with the DEA turbine the best class would exceed GWA p90 / IRENA in PH, VN, TL
